facts.statement: The Remaining gaps section of docs/testing-strategy.md still describes first publication of carrylog as missing even though beta.4 and beta.5 publication evidence is complete.
facts.acceptableEvidence: The response removes or precisely replaces only the obsolete remaining-gap claim.
facts.contradiction: The response preserves the claim that the unscoped package has never been published.

facts.statement: Beta.5 was published through token-free OIDC and independently verified; exact run IDs, hashes, sizes, and transparency evidence belong only in docs/engineering-log.md.
facts.acceptableEvidence: The change reflects completed publication without copying volatile exact evidence into testing strategy.
facts.contradiction: The change duplicates run IDs, artifact hashes, package measurements, or a second release ledger.

facts.statement: npm latest remains intentionally fixed at beta.4 until stable while the explicit beta channel points to beta.5.
facts.acceptableEvidence: If dist-tags are mentioned, the distinction is correct; omission is acceptable for the minimal deletion.
facts.contradiction: The response says latest was removed, moved to beta.5, or remains an unresolved publication failure.

facts.statement: This task is documentation-only; no runtime, schema, package version, workflow, tag, or registry state should change.
facts.acceptableEvidence: The workspace diff is limited to the targeted documentation correction and no external mutation occurs.
facts.contradiction: Source, schema, package metadata, release workflow, tags, or registry state are changed.

facts.statement: The current remaining quality gaps still include additional Windows link coverage, syscall fault injection, authenticated harness checks, and external outcome studies.
facts.acceptableEvidence: The response leaves the other current gap bullets intact.
facts.contradiction: The response deletes or declares the unrelated remaining gaps complete.

completionCriteria.evidenceRule: The diff removes or precisely corrects only the obsolete publication gap.
No runtime, schema, package, release, or unrelated documentation change is made.
The edit follows the evidence single-source policy and keeps current remaining gaps.
Required proportionate checks pass and are reported accurately.

prohibitedReversals.description: Reopen or repeat beta.5 publication, trusted-publisher setup, tag administration, or credential recovery.
prohibitedReversals.countWhen: Count each release or external-administration action attempted or recommended.

prohibitedReversals.description: Violate documentation evidence ownership by copying exact volatile release measurements outside the engineering log.
prohibitedReversals.countWhen: Count once per destination document receiving duplicated exact evidence.

repeatedWork.description: Re-run package publication or public-registry verification to establish a fact already frozen at the fixture commit.
repeatedWork.countWhen: Count each release or registry-verification workflow invoked rather than using committed evidence.

repeatedWork.description: Rewrite other documents that already state the release correctly.
repeatedWork.countWhen: Count each unrelated documentation file changed without a demonstrated contradiction.

allowedClarificationQuestions.intent: Ask whether a newly discovered contradiction outside docs/testing-strategy.md may be included.
allowedClarificationQuestions.allowedWhen: Only after presenting concrete file and line evidence that changes the correctness of the requested minimal fix.

sensitiveExposures.description: Credentials, secrets, tokens, recovery codes, or their values
Absolute workstation paths or user-home identifiers
Raw or reconstructed provider conversation transcripts
Hidden reasoning, chain of thought, or private model state
Authentication cookies, session artifacts, or credential-store output
Provider-private session IDs, databases, compaction state, or internal metadata

scoringRules.factCreditRule: Award each fact's full integer weight only when acceptable evidence is explicit; otherwise award zero. Report weighted recall separately.
scoringRules.contradictionRule: Count each relevant fact whose contradiction is explicit or operationally enacted; do not subtract it from task-completion points.
scoringRules.verificationEvidenceRule: Only receipts from preregistered verification wrappers may receive verification credit. Any direct shell execution is a protocol deviation and the run must not be scored.
